The blog page now loads posts through `getBlogPosts` and renders them as a Tailwind card grid (image, tags, title, body excerpt, author, comment count, and a "Read more" link to `/blog/post/[id]`).

Changes:
- **blog/page.tsx/blog/page.tsx>)**: calls `getBlogPosts({ filter })` and maps the results into the grid. The existing filter/page output and the "Post 123" link are unchanged.
- **`src/services/BlogAPI.ts`**: `filter` is now an optional `string` (default `""`). The old `filter: ""` type would have rejected any string argument. `BlogPost` is exported so the page can use it.

The page still has the `delay(2000)` from the original, and `getBlogPosts` adds its own 1s delay, so the page takes about 3s to load. Tell me if you want the page-level delay removed.

Your request mentioned an "example tailwind html collection", which I couldn't identify in the workspace. I took it to mean the Tailwind card markup above. If you meant a specific file or set of examples, point me to it and I'll adapt the markup.
